<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
  }
  body {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #151b3d 0%, #06080f 75%);
    touch-action: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 1px rgba(130, 150, 255, 0.25),
      0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
      0 0 90px rgba(70, 100, 255, 0.18);
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600">Your browser does not support the HTML canvas element.</canvas>
<script>
'use strict';

/* ============================== Config ============================== */
const W = 800, H = 600;             // logical playfield size, scaled to fit the window
const HUD_H = 50;                   // score bar height; the ball bounces off its lower edge
const FONT = '"Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif';
const START_LIVES = 3;
const PADDLE_KEY_SPEED = 760;       // px/s when steering with the keyboard
const MAX_BOUNCE = Math.PI / 3;     // steepest deflection off the paddle edge (60 degrees)
const SPEED_STEP = 3;               // ball speed gained per brick hit (px/s)
const BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_GAP = 6, BRICK_TOP = HUD_H + 40, BRICK_SIDE = 30;
const BEST_KEY = 'brickBreaker.bestScore';
const ROW_COLORS = ['#ff4d6d', '#ff8c42', '#ffd23f', '#3ddc97', '#3fa7ff', '#9b5de5', '#f15bb5', '#2ee6d6'];
const SILVER = '#b9c6da', GOLD = '#f7c548';

// Each digit is how many hits a brick takes ('.' = empty): 3 = gold, 2 = silver, 1 = row colour.
const LEVELS = [
  {
    title: 'LEVEL 1',
    subtitle: 'Smash every brick!',
    speed: 340, maxSpeed: 520, paddleW: 120,
    map: [
      '1111111111',
      '1111111111',
      '1111111111',
      '1111111111',
      '1111111111',
      '1111111111',
    ],
  },
  {
    title: 'LEVEL 2',
    subtitle: 'Faster ball, armored bricks',
    speed: 400, maxSpeed: 600, paddleW: 104,
    map: [
      '..3.....3..',
      '...2...2...',
      '..2222222..',
      '.22.222.22.',
      '22222222222',
      '1.1111111.1',
      '1.1.....1.1',
      '...11.11...',
    ],
  },
];

/* ============================== Canvas ============================== */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let viewSX = 1, viewSY = 1;

function resize() {
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 3);
  const s = Math.max(0.25, Math.min((window.innerWidth - 24) / W, (window.innerHeight - 24) / H));
  const cssW = Math.floor(W * s), cssH = Math.floor(H * s);
  canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
  canvas.width = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
  viewSX = canvas.width / W;
  viewSY = canvas.height / H;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

/* ============================ Game state ============================ */
const paddle = { x: W / 2, y: H - 42, w: 120, h: 14 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: 0, r: 7, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 0 };
const keys = { left: false, right: false };
const particles = [], floaters = [], trail = [];
let bricks = [];
let state = 'menu', stateBeforePause = 'serve';
let stateTime = 0, levelTime = 0, clock = 0;
let levelIndex = 0, score = 0, lives = START_LIVES;
let best = loadBest(), bestAtStart = best;
let serveTitle = '', serveSub = '';
let shake = 0, paddleGlow = 0;
let audioCtx = null, muted = false;
let bgGradient = null;

function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v; }

function loadBest() {
  try { return parseInt(localStorage.getItem(BEST_KEY), 10) || 0; } catch (e) { return 0; }
}

function saveBest() {
  try { localStorage.setItem(BEST_KEY, String(best)); } catch (e) { /* storage unavailable */ }
}

function setState(next) {
  state = next;
  stateTime = 0;
  canvas.style.cursor = next === 'serve' || next === 'play' ? 'none' : 'default';
}

/* ========================= Levels & game flow ========================= */
function buildLevel(index) {
  const map = LEVELS[index].map;
  const cols = map[0].length;
  const bw = (W - BRICK_SIDE * 2 - BRICK_GAP * (cols - 1)) / cols;
  bricks = [];
  map.forEach((row, r) => {
    for (let c = 0; c < row.length; c++) {
      const hp = parseInt(row[c], 10);
      if (!(hp > 0)) continue;
      bricks.push({
        x: BRICK_SIDE + c * (bw + BRICK_GAP),
        y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
        w: bw, h: BRICK_H, hp, row: r,
        color: ROW_COLORS[r % ROW_COLORS.length],
        flash: 0,
        delay: r * 0.06 + c * 0.018,   // staggered drop-in animation
      });
    }
  });
  levelTime = 0;
}

function loadLevel(index) {
  const def = LEVELS[index];
  levelIndex = index;
  buildLevel(index);
  paddle.w = def.paddleW;
  paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x, paddle.w / 2, W - paddle.w / 2);
  particles.length = 0;
  floaters.length = 0;
  serveTitle = def.title;
  serveSub = def.subtitle;
  resetBall();
  setState('serve');
}

function startGame() {
  score = 0;
  lives = START_LIVES;
  bestAtStart = best;
  loadLevel(0);
}

function resetBall() {
  ball.speed = LEVELS[levelIndex].speed;
  ball.vx = ball.vy = 0;
  trail.length = 0;
  stickBall();
}

function stickBall() {
  ball.x = paddle.x;
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
}

function launchBall() {
  // Launch toward the steering direction if a key is held, otherwise randomly left or right.
  const dir = keys.left !== keys.right ? (keys.left ? -1 : 1) : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
  const angle = dir * (0.2 + Math.random() * 0.35);
  ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
  serveTitle = serveSub = '';
  setState('play');
  sfx('launch');
}

function loseLife() {
  lives--;
  shake = 0.35;
  if (lives <= 0) {
    lives = 0;
    setState('gameOver');
    sfx('gameOver');
    return;
  }
  sfx('lose');
  serveTitle = lives === 1 ? 'LAST LIFE!' : lives + ' LIVES LEFT';
  serveSub = '';
  resetBall();
  setState('serve');
}

function levelCleared() {
  trail.length = 0;
  if (levelIndex + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
    setState('levelClear');
    sfx('levelClear');
  } else {
    setState('victory');
    sfx('victory');
  }
}

function addScore(points) {
  score += points;
  if (score > best) {
    best = score;
    saveBest();
  }
}

/* ============================== Input ============================== */
function onAction() {
  ensureAudio();
  switch (state) {
    case 'menu': startGame(); break;
    case 'serve': launchBall(); break;
    case 'paused': setState(stateBeforePause); break;
    case 'levelClear': if (stateTime > 0.6) loadLevel(levelIndex + 1); break;
    case 'gameOver':
    case 'victory': if (stateTime > 1) startGame(); break;
  }
}

function togglePause() {
  if (state === 'serve' || state === 'play') {
    stateBeforePause = state;
    setState('paused');
  } else if (state === 'paused') {
    setState(stateBeforePause);
  }
}

function toggleMute() {
  muted = !muted;
  if (!muted) ensureAudio();
}

function keyDirection(e) {
  if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'Left') return -1;
  if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'Right') return 1;
  return 0;
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;   // leave browser shortcuts alone
  const dir = keyDirection(e);
  if (dir) {
    if (dir < 0) keys.left = true; else keys.right = true;
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }
  const c = e.code, k = e.key;
  if (c === 'Space' || c === 'Enter' || c === 'NumpadEnter' || c === 'ArrowUp' ||
      k === ' ' || k === 'Spacebar' || k === 'Enter') {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!e.repeat) onAction();
  } else if (c === 'KeyP' || c === 'Escape' || k === 'p' || k === 'P' || k === 'Escape' || k === 'Esc') {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!e.repeat) togglePause();
  } else if (c === 'KeyM' || k === 'm' || k === 'M') {
    if (!e.repeat) toggleMute();
  }
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  const dir = keyDirection(e);
  if (dir < 0) keys.left = false;
  else if (dir > 0) keys.right = false;
});

function pointerToX(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return rect.width ? (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width) : paddle.x;
}

function movePaddleTo(x) {
  if (state !== 'serve' && state !== 'play') return;
  paddle.x = clamp(x, paddle.w / 2, W - paddle.w / 2);
  if (state === 'serve') stickBall();
}

window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => movePaddleTo(pointerToX(e)));
window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0) return;
  movePaddleTo(pointerToX(e));
  onAction();
  movePaddleTo(pointerToX(e));
});
window.addEventListener('pointerup', ensureAudio);   // touch input only unlocks audio on release
window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
  keys.left = keys.right = false;
  if (state === 'play') togglePause();
});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  if (document.hidden && state === 'play') togglePause();
});

/* ============================== Sound ============================== */
function ensureAudio() {
  try {
    if (!audioCtx) {
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AC) return;
      audioCtx = new AC();
    }
    if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
      const p = audioCtx.resume();
      if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {});
    }
  } catch (e) { /* audio unavailable */ }
}

function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo, delay) {
  if (!audioCtx || muted || audioCtx.state !== 'running') return;
  const t0 = audioCtx.currentTime + (delay || 0);
  const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
  osc.type = type;
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
  if (slideTo) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t0 + dur);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t0);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  osc.start(t0);
  osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
}

function sfx(name, arg) {
  switch (name) {
    case 'paddle': tone(300, 0.09, 'square', 0.05, 450); break;
    case 'wall': tone(210, 0.04, 'square', 0.03); break;
    case 'hit': tone(340, 0.07, 'triangle', 0.1); break;
    case 'break': tone(520 + arg * 55, 0.08, 'square', 0.045); break;
    case 'launch': tone(440, 0.1, 'triangle', 0.08, 880); break;
    case 'lose': tone(380, 0.5, 'sawtooth', 0.06, 70); break;
    case 'levelClear': [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.16, 'square', 0.045, 0, i * 0.1)); break;
    case 'victory': [523, 659, 784, 1047, 784, 1047, 1319].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.22, 'square', 0.045, 0, i * 0.12)); break;
    case 'gameOver': [392, 330, 262, 196].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.3, 'triangle', 0.1, 0, i * 0.2)); break;
  }
}

/* ============================== Update ============================== */
function update(dt) {
  clock += dt;
  if (state === 'paused') return;
  stateTime += dt;
  levelTime += dt;
  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt);
  paddleGlow = Math.max(0, paddleGlow - dt * 3);
  for (const b of bricks) b.flash = Math.max(0, b.flash - dt * 6);

  if (state === 'serve' || state === 'play') {
    const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
    if (dir) paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x + dir * PADDLE_KEY_SPEED * dt, paddle.w / 2, W - paddle.w / 2);
  }
  if (state === 'serve') {
    stickBall();
  } else if (state === 'play') {
    updateBall(dt);
    if (state === 'play') {
      trail.push({ x: ball.x, y: ball.y });
      if (trail.length > 12) trail.shift();
    }
  }
  if (state === 'victory' && particles.length < 600 && Math.random() < dt * 3) firework();
  updateEffects(dt);
}

function updateBall(dt) {
  // Sub-step so the ball never moves more than ~3px at a time (no tunnelling through bricks).
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(ball.speed * dt / 3));
  const h = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    ball.x += ball.vx * h;
    ball.y += ball.vy * h;

    if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); sfx('wall'); }
    else if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); sfx('wall'); }
    if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); sfx('wall'); }

    if (ball.vy > 0 && ball.y < paddle.y + paddle.h &&
        circleHitsRect(paddle.x - paddle.w / 2, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h)) {
      bounceOffPaddle();
    }

    const brick = findBrickHit();
    if (brick) {
      deflect(brick);
      hitBrick(brick);
      if (state !== 'play') return;   // that was the last brick
    }

    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) { loseLife(); return; }
  }
}

function circleHitsRect(x, y, w, h) {
  const dx = ball.x - clamp(ball.x, x, x + w);
  const dy = ball.y - clamp(ball.y, y, y + h);
  return dx * dx + dy * dy < ball.r * ball.r;
}

function bounceOffPaddle() {
  // Where the ball lands decides the outgoing angle: centre = straight up, edges = steep.
  const t = clamp((ball.x - paddle.x) / (paddle.w / 2 + ball.r), -1, 1);
  const angle = t * MAX_BOUNCE + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04;
  ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 0.5;
  paddleGlow = 1;
  sfx('paddle');
}

function findBrickHit() {
  let hit = null, nearest = ball.r * ball.r;
  for (const b of bricks) {
    const dx = ball.x - clamp(ball.x, b.x, b.x + b.w);
    const dy = ball.y - clamp(ball.y, b.y, b.y + b.h);
    const d = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    if (d < nearest) { nearest = d; hit = b; }
  }
  return hit;
}

function deflect(b) {
  // Bounce along the axis with the smaller overlap and push the ball back out of the brick.
  const penL = ball.x + ball.r - b.x, penR = b.x + b.w - (ball.x - ball.r);
  const penT = ball.y + ball.r - b.y, penB = b.y + b.h - (ball.y - ball.r);
  if (Math.min(penL, penR) < Math.min(penT, penB)) {
    if (penL < penR) { ball.x -= penL; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    else { ball.x += penR; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  } else if (penT < penB) {
    ball.y -= penT; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy);
  } else {
    ball.y += penB; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy);
  }
}

function hitBrick(b) {
  const cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
  const shardColor = brickColor(b);
  const points = 10 * (levelIndex + 1);
  b.hp--;
  b.flash = 1;
  addScore(points);
  floaters.push({ x: cx, y: cy, text: '+' + points, life: 0.9 });

  // Every hit makes the ball a little faster, up to the level's cap.
  const v = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) || 1;
  ball.speed = Math.min(ball.speed + SPEED_STEP, LEVELS[levelIndex].maxSpeed);
  ball.vx *= ball.speed / v;
  ball.vy *= ball.speed / v;

  if (b.hp > 0) {
    burst(cx, cy, shardColor, 6, 0.6);
    sfx('hit');
    return;
  }
  bricks.splice(bricks.indexOf(b), 1);
  burst(cx, cy, shardColor, 18, 1);
  sfx('break', b.row);
  if (bricks.length === 0) levelCleared();
}

/* ============================== Effects ============================== */
function burst(x, y, color, count, power) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = (50 + Math.random() * 230) * power;
    const life = 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.45;
    particles.push({
      x, y, color, life, maxLife: life,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 40 * power,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
    });
  }
}

function firework() {
  const color = ROW_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ROW_COLORS.length)];
  burst(100 + Math.random() * (W - 200), HUD_H + 60 + Math.random() * 200, color, 28, 1.3);
}

function updateEffects(dt) {
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      particles[i] = particles[particles.length - 1];
      particles.pop();
      continue;
    }
    p.vy += 520 * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
  }
  for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = floaters[i];
    f.life -= dt;
    f.y -= 38 * dt;
    if (f.life <= 0) floaters.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/* ============================== Rendering ============================== */
function render() {
  ctx.setTransform(viewSX, 0, 0, viewSY, 0, 0);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  drawBackground();
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0 && state !== 'paused') {
    const m = shake * 16;
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * m);
  }
  drawBricks();
  if (state !== 'victory') drawParticles();   // victory draws them above its overlay
  drawPaddle();
  if (state === 'menu' || state === 'serve' || state === 'play' || state === 'paused') drawBall();
  drawFloaters();
  ctx.restore();
  drawHUD();
  drawOverlay();
}

function pathRoundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawBackground() {
  if (!bgGradient) {
    bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#121838');
    bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#070a18');
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120, 140, 255, 0.06)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let x = 40; x < W; x += 40) { ctx.moveTo(x, HUD_H); ctx.lineTo(x, H); }
  for (let y = HUD_H + 40; y < H; y += 40) { ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); }
  ctx.stroke();
}

function brickColor(b) {
  return b.hp >= 3 ? GOLD : b.hp === 2 ? SILVER : b.color;
}

function drawBricks() {
  for (const b of bricks) {
    const t = clamp((levelTime - b.delay) / 0.35, 0, 1);
    if (t === 0) continue;
    const e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
    const y = b.y - (1 - e) * 26;
    ctx.globalAlpha = e;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)';
    pathRoundRect(b.x + 2, y + 4, b.w, b.h, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = brickColor(b);
    pathRoundRect(b.x, y, b.w, b.h, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
    pathRoundRect(b.x + 3, y + 2, b.w - 6, b.h * 0.38, 3);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, y + b.h - 5, b.w - 8, 3);

  if (state === 'serve' || state === 'play') {
    const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
    if (dir) paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x + dir * PADDLE_KEY_SPEED * dt, paddle.w / 2, W - paddle.w / 2);
  }
  if (state === 'serve') {
    stickBall();
  } else if (state === 'play') {
    updateBall(dt);
    if (state === 'play') {
      trail.push({ x: ball.x, y: ball.y });
      if (trail.length > 12) trail.shift();
    }
  }
  if (state === 'victory' && particles.length < 600 && Math.random() < dt * 3) firework();
  updateEffects(dt);
}

function updateBall(dt) {
  // Sub-step so the ball never moves more than ~3px at a time (no tunnelling through bricks).
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(ball.speed * dt / 3));
  const h = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    ball.x += ball.vx * h;
    ball.y += ball.vy * h;

    if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); sfx('wall'); }
    else if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); sfx('wall'); }
    if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); sfx('wall'); }

    if (ball.vy > 0 && ball.y < paddle.y + paddle.h &&
        circleHitsRect(paddle.x - paddle.w / 2, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h)) {
      bounceOffPaddle();
    }

    const brick = findBrickHit();
    if (brick) {
      deflect(brick);
      hitBrick(brick);
      if (state !== 'play') return;   // that was the last brick
    }

    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) { loseLife(); return; }
  }
}

function circleHitsRect(x, y, w, h) {
  const dx = ball.x - clamp(ball.x, x, x + w);
  const dy = ball.y - clamp(ball.y, y, y + h);
  return dx * dx + dy * dy < ball.r * ball.r;
}

function bounceOffPaddle() {
  // Where the ball lands decides the outgoing angle: centre = straight up, edges = steep.
  const t = clamp((ball.x - paddle.x) / (paddle.w / 2 + ball.r), -1, 1);
  const angle = t * MAX_BOUNCE + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04;
  ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 0.5;
  paddleGlow = 1;
  sfx('paddle');
}

function findBrickHit() {
  let hit = null, nearest = ball.r * ball.r;
  for (const b of bricks) {
    const dx = ball.x - clamp(ball.x, b.x, b.x + b.w);
    const dy = ball.y - clamp(ball.y, b.y, b.y + b.h);
    const d = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    if (d < nearest) { nearest = d; hit = b; }
  }
  return hit;
}

function deflect(b) {
  // Bounce along the axis with the smaller overlap and push the ball back out of the brick.
  const penL = ball.x + ball.r - b.x, penR = b.x + b.w - (ball.x - ball.r);
  const penT = ball.y + ball.r - b.y, penB = b.y + b.h - (ball.y - ball.r);
  if (Math.min(penL, penR) < Math.min(penT, penB)) {
    if (penL < penR) { ball.x -= penL; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    else { ball.x += penR; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  } else if (penT < penB) {
    ball.y -= penT; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy);
  } else {
    ball.y += penB; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy);
  }
}

function hitBrick(b) {
  const cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
  const shardColor = brickColor(b);
  const points = 10 * (levelIndex + 1);
  b.hp--;
  b.flash = 1;
  addScore(points);
  floaters.push({ x: cx, y: cy, text: '+' + points, life: 0.9 });

  // Every hit makes the ball a little faster, up to the level's cap.
  const v = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) || 1;
  ball.speed = Math.min(ball.speed + SPEED_STEP, LEVELS[levelIndex].maxSpeed);
  ball.vx *= ball.speed / v;
  ball.vy *= ball.speed / v;

  if (b.hp > 0) {
    burst(cx, cy, shardColor, 6, 0.6);
    sfx('hit');
    return;
  }
  bricks.splice(bricks.indexOf(b), 1);
  burst(cx, cy, shardColor, 18, 1);
  sfx('break', b.row);
  if (bricks.length === 0) levelCleared();
}

/* ============================== Effects ============================== */
function burst(x, y, color, count, power) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = (50 + Math.random() * 230) * power;
    const life = 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.45;
    particles.push({
      x, y, color, life, maxLife: life,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 40 * power,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
    });
  }
}

function firework() {
  const color = ROW_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ROW_COLORS.length)];
  burst(100 + Math.random() * (W - 200), HUD_H + 60 + Math.random() * 200, color, 28, 1.3);
}

function updateEffects(dt) {
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      particles[i] = particles[particles.length - 1];
      particles.pop();
      continue;
    }
    p.vy += 520 * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
  }
  for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = floaters[i];
    f.life -= dt;
    f.y -= 38 * dt;
    if (f.life <= 0) floaters.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/* ============================== Rendering ============================== */
function render() {
  ctx.setTransform(viewSX, 0, 0, viewSY, 0, 0);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  drawBackground();
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0 && state !== 'paused') {
    const m = shake * 16;
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * m);
  }
  drawBricks();
  if (state !== 'victory') drawParticles();   // victory draws them above its overlay
  drawPaddle();
  if (state === 'menu' || state === 'serve' || state === 'play' || state === 'paused') drawBall();
  drawFloaters();
  ctx.restore();
  drawHUD();
  drawOverlay();
}

function pathRoundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawBackground() {
  if (!bgGradient) {
    bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#121838');
    bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#070a18');
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120, 140, 255, 0.06)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let x = 40; x < W; x += 40) { ctx.moveTo(x, HUD_H); ctx.lineTo(x, H); }
  for (let y = HUD_H + 40; y < H; y += 40) { ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); }
  ctx.stroke();
}

function brickColor(b) {
  return b.hp >= 3 ? GOLD : b.hp === 2 ? SILVER : b.color;
}

function drawBricks() {
  for (const b of bricks) {
    const t = clamp((levelTime - b.delay) / 0.35, 0, 1);
    if (t === 0) continue;
    const e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
    const y = b.y - (1 - e) * 26;
    ctx.globalAlpha = e;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)';
    pathRoundRect(b.x + 2, y + 4, b.w, b.h, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = brickColor(b);
    pathRoundRect(b.x, y, b.w, b.h, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
    pathRoundRect(b.x + 3, y + 2, b.w - 6, b.h * 0.38, 3);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, y + b.h - 5, b.w - 8, 3);
    if (b.hp > 1) {   // armored bricks get an inner frame
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      pathRoundRect(b.x + 3.5, y + 3.5, b.w - 7, b.h - 7, 3);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    if (b.flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + (b.flash * 0.85).toFixed(3) + ')';
      pathRoundRect(b.x, y, b.w, b.h, 5);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawPaddle() {
  const x = paddle.x - paddle.w / 2, y = paddle.y;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + paddle.w, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#4361ee');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#4cc9f0');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#4361ee');
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(76, 201, 240, ' + (0.5 + paddleGlow * 0.5).toFixed(3) + ')';
  ctx.shadowBlur = (14 + paddleGlow * 20) * viewSX;
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  pathRoundRect(x, y, paddle.w, paddle.h, paddle.h / 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45)';
  pathRoundRect(x + 8, y + 2, paddle.w - 16, 4, 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBall() {
  for (let i = 0; i < trail.length; i++) {
    const k = (i + 1) / trail.length;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150, 210, 255, ' + (k * 0.22).toFixed(3) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(trail[i].x, trail[i].y, ball.r * (0.35 + 0.65 * k), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x - 2, ball.y - 2, 1, ball.x, ball.y, ball.r);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#a9d8ff');
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(190, 230, 255, 0.9)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14 * viewSX;
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.maxLife, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawFloaters() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = '700 14px ' + FONT;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff3b0';
  for (const f of floaters) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(f.life / 0.9, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8, 11, 30, 0.92)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120, 140, 255, 0.35)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H - 1, W, 1);

  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  hudItem('SCORE', String(score), 24, 'left');
  hudItem('BEST', String(best), 150, 'left');
  hudItem('LEVEL', (levelIndex + 1) + ' / ' + LEVELS.length, W / 2, 'center');

  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.font = '600 11px ' + FONT;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8f9bc7';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES', W - 24, 19);
  for (let i = 0; i < START_LIVES; i++) {
    drawHeart(W - 32 - (START_LIVES - 1 - i) * 22, 25, 16, i < lives);
  }
  if (muted) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8f9bc7';
    ctx.fillText('SOUND OFF (M)', W - 104, 41);
  }
}

function hudItem(label, value, x, align) {
  ctx.textAlign = align;
  ctx.font = '600 11px ' + FONT;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8f9bc7';
  ctx.fillText(label, x, 19);
  ctx.font = '700 20px ' + FONT;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(value, x, 41);
}

function drawHeart(cx, top, s, filled) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, top + s * 0.3);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx, top, cx - s / 2, top, cx - s / 2, top + s * 0.3);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - s / 2, top + s * 0.6, cx, top + s * 0.75, cx, top + s);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx, top + s * 0.75, cx + s / 2, top + s * 0.6, cx + s / 2, top + s * 0.3);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + s / 2, top, cx, top, cx, top + s * 0.3);
  ctx.closePath();
  if (filled) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4d6d';
    ctx.fill();
  } else {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function text(str, x, y, size, color, weight) {
  ctx.font = weight + ' ' + size + 'px ' + FONT;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(str, x, y);
}

function glowText(str, x, y, size, color, glow) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = glow;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 18 * viewSX;
  text(str, x, y, size, color, 800);
  ctx.restore();
}

function blinkText(str, y, size, alpha) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  text(str, W / 2, y, size, '#ffffff', 700);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function title(str, y, size, colors) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.font = '800 ' + size + 'px ' + FONT;
  const half = ctx.measureText(str).width / 2;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(W / 2 - half, 0, W / 2 + half, 0);
  colors.forEach((c, i) => g.addColorStop(i / (colors.length - 1), c));
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(90, 120, 255, 0.55)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 24 * viewSX;
  ctx.fillText(str, W / 2, y);
  ctx.restore();
}

function dim(alpha) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 7, 18, ' + alpha + ')';
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
}

function bestLine(y) {
  if (score > bestAtStart) text('NEW BEST SCORE!', W / 2, y, 18, GOLD, 800);
  else text('Best: ' + best, W / 2, y, 17, '#aab4d8', 500);
}

function drawMenu(blink) {
  dim(0.62);
  title('BRICK BREAKER', 182, 64, ['#ff4d6d', '#ffd23f', '#3ddc97', '#3fa7ff']);
  text('2 levels  •  3 lives  •  smash every brick', W / 2, 234, 17, '#aab4d8', 500);

  const bx = W / 2 - 240, by = 268;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
  pathRoundRect(bx, by, 480, 152, 14);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();

  const rows = [
    ['Mouse', 'Move paddle  ·  click to launch'],
    ['← →  or  A / D', 'Move paddle'],
    ['Space  or  ↑', 'Launch ball'],
    ['P / Esc  ·  M', 'Pause  ·  sound on/off'],
  ];
  rows.forEach((row, i) => {
    const y = by + 34 + i * 28;
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    text(row[0], W / 2 - 46, y, 16, '#ffd23f', 700);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    text(row[1], W / 2 - 26, y, 16, '#dfe5ff', 500);
  });
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';

  blinkText('Click or press SPACE to start', 470, 22, blink);
  if (best > 0) text('Best score: ' + best, W / 2, 512, 15, '#8f9bc7', 500);
}

function drawOverlay() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  const blink = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(clock * 5);
  if (state === 'menu') {
    drawMenu(blink);
  } else if (state === 'serve') {
    if (serveTitle) {
      glowText(serveTitle, W / 2, 380, 40, '#ffffff', 'rgba(80, 120, 255, 0.9)');
      if (serveSub) text(serveSub, W / 2, 418, 17, '#aab4d8', 500);
    }
    blinkText('Click or press SPACE to launch', 466, 18, blink);
  } else if (state === 'paused') {
    dim(0.6);
    title('PAUSED', 270, 56, ['#ffffff', '#b9c8ff']);
    text('Press P / Esc or click to resume', W / 2, 328, 18, '#c9d2f2', 500);
  } else if (state === 'levelClear') {
    const next = LEVELS[levelIndex + 1];
    dim(0.65);
    title(LEVELS[levelIndex].title + ' CLEAR!', 225, 56, ['#3ddc97', '#3fa7ff']);
    text('Score: ' + score, W / 2, 288, 26, '#ffffff', 700);
    text('Next up: ' + next.title + ' — ' + next.subtitle, W / 2, 330, 17, '#aab4d8', 500);
    if (stateTime > 0.6) blinkText('Click or press SPACE to continue', 410, 21, blink);
  } else if (state === 'gameOver') {
    dim(0.7);
    title('GAME OVER', 225, 64, ['#ff4d6d', '#ff8c42']);
    text('Score: ' + score, W / 2, 292, 26, '#ffffff', 700);
    bestLine(332);
    if (stateTime > 1) blinkText('Click or press SPACE to play again', 410, 21, blink);
  } else if (state === 'victory') {
    dim(0.55);
    drawParticles();
    title('YOU WIN!', 215, 72, ['#ffd23f', '#ff8c42', '#ff4d6d']);
    text('Both levels cleared!', W / 2, 272, 20, '#dfe5ff', 600);
    text('Final score: ' + score, W / 2, 310, 26, '#ffffff', 700);
    bestLine(350);
    if (stateTime > 1) blinkText('Click or press SPACE to play again', 420, 21, blink);
  }
}

/* ============================== Main loop ============================== */
let lastTime = 0;
function frame(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  const dt = lastTime ? clamp((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0, 1 / 30) : 1 / 60;
  lastTime = now;
  update(dt);
  render();
}

buildLevel(0);
resetBall();
setState('menu');
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

- **3 lives:** shown as hearts in the top bar. Missing the ball costs one life; losing all three shows a Game Over screen, and clearing both levels shows a win screen. Either screen lets you start a new game.
- **Extras:** a pause screen, sound effects, particle bursts when bricks break, and automatic pause when you switch away from the window.

**Controls:**

| Action | Keyboard | Mouse |
|---|---|---|
| Move paddle | ← → or A / D | Move the mouse |
| Start / launch / continue | Space, Enter or ↑ | Left click |
| Pause / resume | P or Esc | Click to resume |
| Sound on/off | M | – |

The ball's angle depends on where it lands on the paddle: the edges send it off steeply, the center sends it nearly straight up. The A/D keys also work with a Korean keyboard layout.
